subtitle: Lesson 17 · Where the state lives now matters

eyebrow: A real Dockerfile, no secrets baked in
code:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
CMD ["python", "agent_service.py"]
caption: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and DB creds come in as env vars at runtime.

eyebrow: A restart is a normal, expected event
